def blkpos(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(17,24) for c in range(10,44) if a[r][c] in ('b','S')]
    cs=[p[1] for p in pts]; rs=[p[0] for p in pts]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
def timer(frame): return sum(1 for r in range(64) if frame.ascii.split('\n')[r][62]=='N')
print("start:",blkpos(current_frame),"timer:",timer(current_frame))
prev=blkpos(current_frame)
for i in range(24):
    action(['LEFT'])
    bp=blkpos(current_frame)
    if bp!=prev:
        print(f"L{i+1}:",bp,"t:",timer(current_frame))
        prev=bp
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("TERMINAL:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'),last_action_result.get('done')); break
print("final:",blkpos(current_frame),"timer:",timer(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
